# clavis members offboarding

<p class="cli-lead">Show or start a departing member&#39;s secret review</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis members offboarding USER [flags]
```

</div>

When someone leaves, list every secret they revealed so you can decide,
key by key, whether to rotate it. `--start` creates a task per secret.

## Examples

```sh
clavis members offboarding ada@example.com
clavis members offboarding ada@example.com --start
```
